name: Hammerslag
description: Realestate agents competite against each other, guessing 3 recently sold house prices per show.

videos.title: Episode 9
videos.overview:
Tonight the realestate agents are on a serious test. The first housing is located in central Nyborg. The tour continues on to Odense, where to guess the price of a unique fully restored townhouse. The evening's third and final villa is found in the small village Lunde, near Otterup. Here in the middle of the village is an impressive mansion with a large park-like grounds. And what is the price of glory?
Host: Christian Degn

videos.title: Wild Renovations
videos.overview: Wild renovations are the theme when host, Sofie Østergaard, offers an inside look at two homes that have received a major overhaul. Jacob Carlsson and Camilla Weidinger compete against Kristine Virén and Lars Lyng when the price of a Funkisvilla in Randers, which has been renovated with great respect for the house's origins, has to be guessed. It will be decisive when the two teams have to guess the price of a villa from 1904 that has been TOTALLY renovated from basement to attic. And the experts get a big surprise in the house's basement - it hides a spa and wellness department.

videos.title: Worker housing for millions
videos.overview: Actually, they were built for the workers. But the prices of Copenhagen's old building association houses have grown to many millions today. Exactly how many, the experts have to guess when Hammerslag is in the capital. This time Christian Torp and Mira Lie Nielsen fight against Kristine Virén and Lars Lyng. First, they have to guess the price of a Humlebyhus with original details and a very small toilet on the stairs. Then the trip goes to the desirable and family-friendly neighborhood Lyset in Valby. Here, a unique and charming yellow house awaits the two teams.

videos.title: Wooden houses for the family
videos.overview: Charming wooden houses that form the framework for good family life - This is the theme when Hammerslag visits two wooden houses on Funen. This time Camilla Weidinger and Jacob Carlsson compete against Christian Torp and Mira Lie Nielsen when prizes have to be guessed. The host, Sofie Østergaard, welcomes you inside an American-inspired wooden house with a formidable view of the Little Belt. And then you have to look at a blue wooden house in Strib.

videos.title: Manor apartments
videos.overview: There is plenty of beautiful stucco and tall wooden panels when the host, Sofie Østergaard, this time invites you inside two classic mansion apartments on Østerbro in Copenhagen. This time, Christian Torp and Mira Lie Nielsen compete against Kristine Virén and Lars Lyng when it comes to a fully renovated apartment with lots of wow factor. After that, the experts must visit a beautiful and stately apartment with room for four children and original, but also slightly crooked, plank floors.

videos.title: 90's house
videos.overview: The nostalgic 90s house, which took inspiration from the burgeoning popular culture, has won back the hearts of home buyers. That's why the host, Sofie Østergaard, this time invites inside two detached houses from the year 1997. Kristine Virén and Lars Lyng are up against Camilla Weidinger and Jacob Carlsson. And the battle to guess the right price starts in Tjæreborg near Esbjerg. Here they have to take a closer look at a house with powder-coloured bricks, a built-in carport and its own children's section. The experts then visit a house in Øster Vedsted near Ribe, which offers many fine details from the 90s and of course also the 90s classic 'pizzabuen'.

videos.title: Summer house idyll on Fanø
videos.overview: You'll be invited inside for genuine summer house idyll when Hammerslag visits the popular holiday island of Fanø. With its many, charming thatched houses and beautiful nature, the island is a favorite holiday destination - and holiday homes are precisely the homes for which prices must be guessed. Camilla Weidinger and Jacob Carlsson compete against Lars Lyng and Kristine Virén. And it is the host, Sofie Østergaard, who invites you inside a listed, thatched cottage, located in historic Sønderho. The trip then continues to a newly renovated summer house in seaside hotel style with a view of the North Sea.

videos.title: From school to home
videos.overview: Shouting children in the school yard, math lessons and the smell of packed lunches are some of the things we usually associate with schools. But that is not the case when Hammerslag visits homes that previously functioned as schools. Camilla Weidinger and Jacob Carlsson compete against Mira Lie Nielsen and Christian Torp Carlsen when host Sofie Østergaard invites you inside the old school in the village of Lee. Here they have to guess the price of a home with its own gymnasium and bow room. Afterwards, the experts will visit the old village school in Roum, which has now been transformed into a private residence with a country kitchen and high ceilings.

videos.title: In the first row on Klippeøen
videos.overview: Bornholm is a much-loved holiday island for many Danes. That is why Hammerslag has this time taken to Klippeøen, where the host, Sofie Østergaard, invites you inside two homes located directly on the Baltic Sea. Lars Lyng and Kristine Virén compete against Christian Torp and Mira Lie Nielsen when the trip first goes to Teglkås, where they have to guess the price of a flexible home that offers many square meters, local materials, and not least a large terrace facing the water. The competition continues in Bølshavn, where they will see a rarely offered house from 1954 with well-preserved details and a view that takes the experts' breath away.

videos.title: Luxury in the Province
videos.overview: Luxury in the province is the theme when host, Sofie Østergaard, offers the inside of two homes, where quality materials have a high priority. Kristine Virén and Lars Lyng compete against Jacob Carlsson and Camilla Weidinger when guessing the price of a luxury apartment in Holbæk, which combines historical charm and modern luxury. It will be decisive when the two teams have to guess the price of an impressive luxury villa in Vipperød, which offers breathtaking sea views and ultimate luxury.

videos.title: The first purchase
videos.overview: Buying a first home is for many a particularly big decision. That is why the host, Sofie Østergaard, this time invites inside two very different homes, which have caused the buyers to enter the housing market. Mira Lie Nielsen and Christian Torp take on Camilla Weidinger and Jacob Carlsson when they first visit Aarhus' Øgade district, where they are impressed by a completely renovated apartment with a townhouse atmosphere. Next, the trip goes to the suburb of Hjortshøj, where they will see a family villa from the 60s with a lovely south-facing garden.

videos.title: Quickly handled on Bornholm
videos.overview: When the dream home is there, you have to act quickly. That's why Hammerslag has taken to Bornholm, where the host, Sofie Østergaard, invites inside two homes that made the buyers fall head over heels in love and act quickly. Lars Lyng and Kristine Virén compete against Christian Torp and Mira Lie Nielsen when they are first impressed by a minimalist wooden house in Allinge with rocks in the backyard. Then the trip goes to Svaneke, where the experts have to guess the price of an adorable, small town house with a view of Svaneke's red tiled roofs.

videos.title: Small log cabins
videos.overview: Inside charming log summerhouses of a few square meters are offered when Hammerslag visits Sjællands Odde. This time, Camilla Weidinger and Jacob Carlsson compete against Kristine Virén and Lars Lyng when the prices of the summer houses have to be guessed. First, the host, Sofie Østergaard, invites you inside an authentic nut-brown log summer house. Then the trip continues to a black modernized log summer house surrounded by beautiful natural grounds.
